title: Review and save
lead: This draft is not saved yet: adjust what you need and press “Save”. It is encrypted right here, on your device.

invalid.title: Cannot read the draft
invalid.text: The link is damaged or cut off. Send the entry again from the extension, CLI or VS Code.

empty.title: No draft here
empty.text: Entries from the Chrome extension, CLI and VS Code land here. Start there — or create an entry by hand.

onboarding.title: Let’s save this to your impact log
onboarding.lead: To save the entry you need a vault on this device. No sign-up required.
onboarding.local: Works without sign-up: the vault is created right in your browser
onboarding.encrypted: Entries are encrypted on your device — nobody else can read them
onboarding.sync: You can turn on sync between devices later
onboarding.keep: The draft won’t be lost: after creating a vault or signing in you’ll come back to it.

duplicate.title: Already saved
duplicate.text: The draft from this link is already in your journal. Open the entry or save the draft again as a new one.
